policy: TEXT FONTS: SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE 1.1 ONLY. Every glyph on screen must be drawn by one of these fonts, each licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 and nothing else (no Apache, UFL, GPL, freeware/'free for commercial use' terms, proprietary, system or remote fonts). The skill does not ship font files: each file is downloaded on demand from the pinned official source below, verified against its sha256, cached, and copied unmodified into the project together with its OFL 1.1 licence file (the licence text itself is verified too). Extend the catalogue only with an SIL OFL 1.1 font from its official source — see SKILL.md → Fonts.

fonts.role: Code, ids, commands, terminal looks, tabular technical labels. Includes Hangul (full-width).
Captions only (the player's one-line subtitles), weight 700.

fonts.role: Serif (바탕/명조): emotional stories, editorial pieces, quotes, literary titles. Regular + Bold.

fonts.role: Ultra-heavy display (검은고딕): punchy headlines, news flashes, warnings, promo slams. Headlines only — ~2,580 common syllables and partial ASCII, so always stack Pretendard after it.
fonts.copyright: © 2015 The Black Han Sans Project Authors (Zess Type)

fonts.role: Rounded, friendly display (배민 주아): education, kids, casual/fun pieces, playful labels. Headlines only — ~2,370 common syllables and partial ASCII, so always stack Pretendard after it.
Handwriting (나눔손글씨 펜): annotations, margin notes, sticky notes, personal asides. Not for body text.
